+# Scoping authorization policies by authentication method
+
+Use `flipt.is_auth_method(input, method)` in a Rego policy to check the numeric `input.authentication.method` value through a readable name. For example:
+
+```rego
+package flipt.authz.v1
+
+import rego.v1
+
+default allow := false
+
+allow if {
+    flipt.is_auth_method(input, "token")
+    input.authentication.metadata["io.flipt.auth.role"] == "admin"
+}
+```
+
+The second argument must be one of these strings:
+
+| Name | Authentication method code |
+| --- | ---: |
+| `token` | 1 |
+| `oidc` | 2 |
+| `kubernetes`, `k8s` | 3 |
+| `github` | 4 |
+| `jwt` | 5 |
+| `cloud` | 6 |
+
+These codes come from `rpc/flipt/auth/auth.proto`. The function returns `true` for a match and `false` for a different method. It reports an error if `authentication` is missing or the name is unsupported.

+func TestEngine_IsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	policy := `package flipt.authz.v1
+import rego.v1
+default allow := false
+allow if {
+    flipt.is_auth_method(input, input.request.method)
+}`
+	server := sdktest.MustNewServer(sdktest.MockBundle("/bundles/bundle.tar.gz", map[string]string{"main.rego": policy}))
+	t.Cleanup(server.Stop)
+
+	config := fmt.Sprintf(`{
+    "services": {"test": {"url": %q}},
+    "bundles": {"test": {"resource": "/bundles/bundle.tar.gz"}}
+}`, server.URL())
+	opa, err := sdk.New(ctx, sdk.Options{Config: strings.NewReader(config), Store: inmem.New()})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	engine := &Engine{opa: opa, logger: zaptest.NewLogger(t)}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, engine.Shutdown(ctx)) })
+
+	input := map[string]any{
+		"authentication": &auth.Authentication{Method: auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN, Metadata: map[string]string{"io.flipt.auth.role": "admin"}},
+		"request":        map[string]any{"method": "token"},
+	}
+	allowed, err := engine.IsAllowed(ctx, input)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.True(t, allowed)
+
+	input["request"] = map[string]any{"method": "jwt"}
+	allowed, err = engine.IsAllowed(ctx, input)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.False(t, allowed)
+
+	input["request"] = map[string]any{"method": "password"}
+	_, err = engine.IsAllowed(ctx, input)
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported auth method: \"password\"")
+
+	delete(input, "authentication")
+	input["request"] = map[string]any{"method": "token"}
+	_, err = engine.IsAllowed(ctx, input)
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+// Package ext registers Flipt built-ins for authorization policies.
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/topdown/builtins"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+var authMethods = map[string]auth.Method{
+	"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+var errNoAuthentication = errors.New("no authentication found")
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name:        "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Description: "Returns whether input.authentication.method matches the named authentication method.",
+		Decl:        types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.NewObject(nil, types.NewDynamicProperty(types.A, types.A)), types.S), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	obj, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, builtins.NewOperandTypeErr(1, input.Value, "object")
+	}
+
+	authentication := obj.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, errNoAuthentication
+	}
+
+	authenticationObj, ok := authentication.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, errNoAuthentication
+	}
+
+	methodName, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, builtins.NewOperandTypeErr(2, key.Value, "string")
+	}
+
+	method, ok := authMethods[string(methodName)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %q", string(methodName))
+	}
+
+	actualMethod := authenticationObj.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actualMethod != nil && actualMethod.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method)))), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		method auth.Method
+	}{
+		{"token", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{"oidc", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
+		{"kubernetes", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"k8s", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"github", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
+		{"jwt", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
+		{"cloud", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			input := authInput(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(tt.method)))
+			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tt.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)
+
+			input = authInput(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(auth.Method_METHOD_NONE)))
+			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tt.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodRegoSignature(t *testing.T) {
+	result, err := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method({"authentication": {"method": 1}}, "token")`),
+		rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+	).Eval(context.Background())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, result, 1)
+	require.Equal(t, true, result[0].Expressions[0].Value)
+
+	for _, query := range []string{
+		`flipt.is_auth_method({"authentication": {"method": 1}})`,
+		`flipt.is_auth_method({"authentication": {"method": 1}}, 1)`,
+	} {
+		t.Run(query, func(t *testing.T) {
+			_, err := rego.New(rego.Query(query)).Eval(context.Background())
+			require.Error(t, err)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.Nil(t, result)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, authInput(ast.IntNumberTerm(1)), ast.StringTerm("password"))
+	require.Nil(t, result)
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported auth method")
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "password")
+}
+
+func authInput(method *ast.Term) *ast.Term {
+	return ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{
+		ast.StringTerm("authentication"),
+		ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{ast.StringTerm("method"), method}),
+	})
+}
